en.title: Irreversible Temporal Displacement in the Permafrost: An Investigation into the Disappearance Case in the Isolated Far N
en.premise: At the Arctic observation base "Ice Castle," three researchers have vanished without a trace within a sealed environment. All that remains are unnaturally arranged belongings in a frozen room and records detailing thermodynamic contradictions that defy the laws of physics. This report reconstructs fragmented observation logs and minute physical traces to examine the feasibility of the crime. The ultimate enigma: how were the "traces" rewritten in an environment where survival is impossible?

zh.title: 冻结层中的不可逆时间位移，亦或极北隔离环境下的消失事件考察
zh.premise: 在极北观测基地“冰之城堡”中，三名研究员在封闭环境下离奇失踪。现场仅发现了冻结室内排列异常的遗留物，以及记录着违背物理定律的热力学矛盾。本报告通过重构碎片化的观测日志与现场细微的物理痕迹，旨在探讨犯罪成立的可能性。令人费解的是：在根本无法生存的环境下，“痕迹”究竟是如何被改写的？
